```{math-exercise}
#| label: variant-triangle
#| variables: |
#|   ab = pick([3, 4, 5])
#|   offset = pick([1, 2])
#|   bc = ab + offset
#|   ratio = bc / sqrt(ab**2 + bc**2)
#|   rounded = round(ratio, 3)
#| field-labels: Ratio
#| note: AB={#ab#}, BC={#bc#}
#| mode: numeric
#| decplaces: 3
#| context-text: Right triangle with legs AB={@ab@}, BC={@bc@}.
#| tests:
#|   - name: exact expression
#|     answers: [ratio]
#|     expect: correct
#|   - name: rounded answer
#|     answers: [rounded]
#|     expect: correct
#|   - name: reversed ratio
#|     answers: [1/ratio]
#|     expect: wrong

A right triangle has legs $AB={@ab@}$ and $BC={@bc@}$.
Find $BC/AC$, to **three decimals**: _[{@ratio@}].
#| solution
Pythagoras gives $AC=\sqrt{{@ab@}^2+{@bc@}^2}$, so $BC/AC={@ratio@}$.
```
